title: Expand route interaction regressions and freeze diagnostics
description:
Problem: the current navigation-freeze test is valuable but narrow, leaving broader route interaction regressions under-protected.

Desired outcome: expand browser regression coverage to include route-specific interaction expectations and standardized freeze diagnostics capture.

Scope:
- In scope: additional deterministic specs for route interaction paths, client-side error capture normalization, and artifact enrichment.
- Out of scope: full UI end-to-end feature testing beyond regression-priority paths.

Dependencies:
- Browser smoke coverage from TSK-0068.

Acceptance criteria:
- Core route interactions have regression specs with clear expected heading/region checks.
- Console/page errors relevant to circuit/render faults are captured in failure output.
- Failure artifacts provide enough context to reproduce lockups quickly.

Validation:
- Run expanded browser suite locally and in CI with at least one induced assertion failure to verify diagnostics.

Rollback:
- Disable newly added flaky specs individually while retaining stable baseline coverage.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from audit finding F-004 to broaden lockup and navigation regression safety net.
